paper_title: Non-halogenated solution-processed ambipolar plastic transistors based on conjugated polymers prepared by asymmetric donor engineering

knowledge_points.content: Asymmetric donor engineering, using units like 2-(thiophen-2-yl)thieno[3,2-b]thiophene and 2-(selenophen-2-yl)thieno[3,2-b]thiophene, is used to disrupt the translational symmetry of the DPP polymer backbone to increase solubility in non-chlorinated solvents.
knowledge_points.evidence: The newly developed asymmetric donor units... enhance the solubility of the polymers due to the randomly oriented irregular backbone. In addition, the well-regulated donor length optimizes the ambipolar character of the polymers.

knowledge_points.content: P29DPP-TTSe polymer films processed in toluene with a DMSO additive achieved a maximum hole mobility of 6.36 cm²/V·s and a maximum electron mobility of 0.71 cm²/V·s.
knowledge_points.evidence: electrical performances of the P29DPP-TTSe polymer films processed in toluene were enhanced to have high hole (6.36 cm2 V-1 s-1) and electron (0.71 cm2 V-1 s-1) mobilities

knowledge_points.content: P29DPP-TTTh and P29DPP-TTSe exhibit HOMO levels of -5.38 eV and -5.37 eV, and LUMO levels of -4.02 eV and -4.04 eV, respectively, facilitating ambipolar transport with gold electrodes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) energy level... were -5.38 eV and -4.02 eV for P29DPP-TTTh and -5.37 eV and -4.04 eV for P29DPP-TTSe

knowledge_points.content: The optical band gaps for P29DPP-TTTh and P29DPP-TTSe, determined from UV-Vis absorption edges, are 1.36 eV and 1.33 eV, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optical band gaps of P29DPP-TTTh and P29DPP-TTSe calculated from the UV-Vis absorption edge were 1.36 eV and 1.33 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) acts as a high-boiling-point, eco-friendly additive that promotes interchain aggregation and the formation of larger nanofibrillar aggregates during film drying.
knowledge_points.evidence: The introduction of high-boiling-point additive allows slow drying and evaporation of the processing solution, which gives the solvated polymer chains more time to aggregate prior to being fixed within the solid thin films.

knowledge_points.content: AFM analysis shows that the addition of DMSO to non-chlorinated polymer solutions increases the diameter of nanofibrillar aggregates from approximately 80 nm to 200 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: AFM analysis revealed that the optimally annealed polymer films... consisted of large and densely packed nanofibrillar networks... additive treatment gave rise to the formation of much larger aggregates of nanofibrils (~200 nm in diameter)

knowledge_points.content: GIXD characterization reveals that both P29DPP-TTTh and P29DPP-TTSe maintain a dominant edge-on orientation relative to the substrate when processed from non-chlorinated solvents like toluene and o-xylene.
knowledge_points.evidence: Comparably high crystalline edge-on orientations were also obtained in polymer films spin-coated in non-chlorinated solvents with high-order out-of-plane diffraction peaks and a discernible in-plane diffraction peak at 1.73 Å-1.

knowledge_points.content: Complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) inverters fabricated using P29DPP-TTSe in a single film deposition step achieved a high average voltage gain of 139.
knowledge_points.evidence: CMOS-like inverter characteristics of P29DPP-TTSe inverters processed in toluene and DMSO additive solution... exhibited high average gains of 139.

knowledge_points.content: TGA analysis indicates that P29DPP-TTTh and P29DPP-TTSe are thermally stable with decomposition temperatures reaching between 460 °C and 480 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: TGA also showed them to be thermally stable up to 460–480 °C.

knowledge_points.content: The use of asymmetric donor segments in the polymer backbone enables high solubility (0.5 wt% / mL) in non-chlorinated solvents such as toluene and o-xylene.
knowledge_points.evidence: The solubility was tested by checking the solution at a concentration of 0.5 wt%/mL... Both polymers with asymmetrically structured donor units showed good solubility in various solvents, including environmentally friendly solvents (e.g., toluene and xylene)

knowledge_points.content: The number of layers in the edge-on lamellae structure, calculated from coherence length and d-spacing (Lc,(100)/d(100)), was found to be approximately 7.7 to 7.9 for films processed in chlorobenzene and toluene.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Lc,(100)/d(100) value of the P29DPP-TTTh polymer films processed in CB, toluene and o-xylene was estimated to be 7.7, 6.7 and 6.5 layers... The estimated numbers of layers within P29DPP-TTSe polymer films in CB, toluene and o-xylene were 7.9, 7.7 and 7.4

knowledge_points.content: To accurately characterize the mobility of DPP-based polymers exhibiting non-linear transfer curves, a reliability factor (r) is used, which for these polymers ranged from 7% to 21% depending on the solvent and additive.
